verdict.rationale: Paxos supports scoped API credentials via Client ID/Secret with configurable allowed scopes to restrict endpoint access, and separately supports OAuth 2.0 authentication — a foundation for least-privilege credentialing. However, none of this is framed around AI agents specifically; there's no agent-specific credential issuance, delegation, or dynamic/short-lived scoped tokens tailored for autonomous agent use. Missing for 10: agent-specific credential workflows, dynamic/ephemeral scoped tokens for agents, and any documentation tying scopes to AI-agent use cases.
